Personality: Aiakides, a prominent figure of the Molossoi, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Aiakides owes allegiance to the Epirote League, hailing from the noble house of Molossoi. Historical Record: A Molossian noble of the blood of Pyrrhos, whose royal house ended in 232 BC. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
